verified_behavior: Preflight uses allowlisted local mock ATS structured metadata only; each required question maps to approved fact/answer identifiers, minimal name/email profile paths, prepared document kinds, or the deterministic application ID.

Verified, user-approved, sufficiently confident, sourced facts and answers satisfy a mapping. Missing required values produce FAIL with exact question and missing identifiers; optional questions do not fail; unmapped or unsupported metadata produces UNKNOWN.
Metadata is hashed and re-read before the browser starts. Changed or unavailable second-read metadata produces UNKNOWN/STALE_PREFLIGHT and leaves the browser unopened.
FAIL and UNKNOWN persist value-free audit evidence and transition the application to REVIEW_REQUIRED before Playwright starts. Only a stable PASS reaches browser automation.
The application detail API and browser view show result, timestamp, reason, and precise unresolved question mappings. Application ownership is checked before this profile-scoped evidence is returned.
The existing dry-run still stops before submission; fictional submit requires its existing explicit consent. External submission remained OFF.
limitations: The only application automation provider supported by this repository is the local fictional mock ATS. Real Greenhouse, Workday, and other providers remain unsupported and manual-only; unsupported ATS preflight is UNKNOWN. Generic HTML is not treated as structured capability evidence.
Docker/PostgreSQL and hosted Actions/review evidence were NOT_RUN under the active local-only policy. No real employer or ATS was contacted and no external application was submitted.
Original MJ-REQ accounting and denominator remain unchanged; full product/release acceptance remains NOT_RUN.
